FE_460_ptah_fencing_production_wiring.classification: official artifact support plus independent static/live-test artifact reproduction

public_primary.title: fix(inference): a worker takes the run, so the fence has something to move (#2474)

FE_460_ptah_fencing_production_wiring.reproduced_observation: The store-side fencing predicate already existed, but production did not issue a later token: prepare wrote token 1 and Run.Claim had no production caller. The merged repair replaces the prepare literal with Claim, adds a persisted engine claim before Backfill/CatchUp work, and includes a live negative in which worker A is rejected after worker B advances the token plus a positive control where B commits.
FE_460_ptah_fencing_production_wiring.exact_scope: Ptah inference prepare/backfill/catchup ownership transition and PostgreSQL live fencing tests in PR #2480; not multi-host/network-partition evidence and not a generic fencing-family result

public_primary.title: fix(inference): call the rule that decides what a write does (#2391)

acceptance_implication.classification: downstream verification criterion supported by two exact Ptah counterexamples
acceptance_implication.statement: A safety helper, resource predicate, or green direct-unit test is insufficient Phase-1 evidence unless at least one real production entry-point path actually invokes/advances the mechanism and a discriminating test fails when that production wiring is removed.
acceptance_implication.scope_guard: This is a verification criterion motivated by FE-460/461; it does not assert that every helper is unwired or every system needs Ptah's exact implementation.
